text:
Tomorrow
+
+they will dress me in ashes at dawn,
+
+they will fill my mouth with flowers.
+
+I shall learn to sleep
+
+in the memory of a wall,
+
+in the breathing of an animal that dreams.

translation.title: Tomorrow…
translation.editorial_note: The anticipated burial passes from ash and flowers into an apprenticeship in sleep, housed within wall-memory and an animal’s dream-breath.
